description: This file contains functions and types related to uninstalling plugins in the OpenClaw project, including resolving uninstall directories, removing plugin references from configuration, and performing the uninstall process with optional file deletion.

methods.name: resolveUninstallDirectoryTarget
methods.description: Determines the directory path to uninstall for a plugin, considering install status and configuration.

methods.name: resolveUninstallChannelConfigKeys
methods.description: Resolves the set of channel configuration keys owned by a plugin during uninstall.

methods.name: removePluginFromConfig
methods.description: Removes all references to a plugin from the configuration object, including entries, installs, allowlist, load paths, slots, and channels.

methods.name: uninstallPlugin
methods.description: Performs plugin uninstallation by updating configuration and optionally deleting plugin files from disk.
